name: Café Ehaburu ~White Version~
original_name: カフェ・エハーブル ～White version～
source:
A coffee shop with maids becomes a cozy and peaceful place to come and relax. Main character is entrusted to manage competition between two maids. It all starts with cooking, but number of services increases rapidly.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女仆咖啡馆原本是让人放松身心的温馨宁静之所。主人公受托主持Ehaburu咖啡馆两名女仆之间的比赛。起初只是比拼厨艺，随后服务项目却迅速增加。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
